context: A family heads to a baseball game via the subway
purpose: Teach: 車両/経由/地下鉄/有料/観戦/一貫/掲げ/違和感

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ねえパパ、地下鉄でほんとに球場まで行けるの？
lines.en: Hey Dad, can we really get to the stadium by subway?
lines.style: Excited child question, rising tone, eager and curious

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: うん、新宿経由で一本だよ。乗り換えなしで楽だぞ。
lines.en: Yeah, one line via Shinjuku. Easy, no transfers needed.
lines.style: Reassuring dad explanation, calm and confident tone

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: やった！ねえ、先頭車両に乗りたい！運転席が見えるやつ！
lines.en: Yes! Hey, I want to ride the front car! The one where you see the driver!
lines.style: Loud childlike excitement, bouncing energy, pleading and earnest

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: いいよ。でも今日は有料の特急じゃなくて普通だから、ちょっと混むぞ。
lines.en: Sure. But today's just a regular one, not the paid express, so it'll be packed.
lines.style: Gentle warning from dad, practical and matter-of-fact

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: パパ、応援団がでっかい旗を掲げてるの、テレビで見たよ！僕もタオル振っていい？
lines.en: Dad, I saw the cheer squad raising huge flags on TV! Can I wave my towel too?
lines.style: Animated child recounting, enthusiastic and proud delivery

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: もちろん。観戦はみんなで声出すのが一番楽しいんだ。パパはずっと一貫してジャイアンツ一筋だぞ。
lines.en: Of course. Yelling together is the best part of watching the game. I've stuck with the Giants consistently the whole time.
lines.style: Warm fatherly nostalgia, slight chuckle, proudly sharing tradition

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: でもさあ、僕だけユニフォーム着てないと、なんか違和感あるよぉ。
lines.en: But hey, if I'm the only one without a uniform, it feels kinda off.
lines.style: Sheepish child whine, slightly pouting and self-conscious

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: はは、じゃあ売店で買おう。さあ、次の駅で降りるぞ、準備して。
lines.en: Haha, then let's buy one at the stand. Okay, we get off at the next stop, get ready.
lines.style: Cheerful dad laughing, then switching to brisk practical mode
